# The examples page says what it is and that an example opens live

## Context

On 16 Nov 2026 two readers without session context read the examples' first screen in four still frames (#21121, [the look and its cold reads](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21121#issuecomment-6914642220)). In the second round both named the same gap outside the covers, unprompted: "Nothing says 'try it live'" (the engineer), and "Nothing says 'open this live': no visible button or cue, no one-line explanation of what Neo.mjs is, and the window badge and the 'Build: Production' rail label are unexplained" (the AI agent).

A leaf of #20498, cornerstone 1 of Engine 14 (`ROADMAP.md`), cut on Mon 23 Nov.

## The Problem

On the branch of #21124 a card at rest shows a cover, a title and one proof line. The action, the limits and the source link open on hover, focus and selection. A stranger who looks before moving the pointer sees a gallery of pictures:

- no cue that a click runs the example in their browser;
- no sentence that says what the page lists. A visitor who lands on `/examples/gantt` from a search has not seen the home page;
- a window icon on some covers that nothing explains before hover (its tooltip is "Multi Window Demo").

Observed: two of two readers in that round. Not observed: a visitor who failed to click. The reads were of still frames.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/portal/view/examples/List.mjs`: `createItemContent` builds the card, including the `neo-multi-window` badge; the action row is revealed by state (hover, focus, selection; a tapped card opens under its cover at phone widths). #21119 decided that composition.
- `resources/scss/src/apps/portal/examples/List.scss`: the card's styles.
- `apps/portal/view/examples/TabContainer.mjs`: the section. Nothing renders above a list.
- Design authority: "a stranger evaluating the engine opens the portal's examples and reads, per component family, what each example shows and why it matters" (#20498, terminal predicate). #21119 made the card say less. It did not decide that the page says nothing about itself.

## The Fix

The look comes first, on #21130's board: it is the same first screen.

1. **One line above the cards of every tab:** what the page lists, that each example runs live in the browser, and how many the tab holds. A family uses its own sentence where it has one (#21116).
2. **A resting cue on the card that it opens:** small, on the caption, the same in both themes. On hover, focus and selection it gives way to the full action.
3. **The window badge reads without hover:** an accessible name, and a word beside the icon where the card has room.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] At 1440×900 and 390×844 a frame of `/examples` at rest shows one line that says what the page lists and that an example opens live.
- [ ] Every card shows at rest that it opens. The cue meets 4.5:1 against the caption in both themes, and the resting caption still leaves at least 45 % of the cover clear (30 % at phone widths), as #21119 set.
- [ ] The multi-window badge has an accessible name and reads without hover.
- [ ] `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` covers the line and the cue.
- [ ] **Look:** the pull request shows the whole first screen as released and as changed, and two readers without session context are asked what they would do next on the page. Both name opening an example.

## Out of Scope

The covers (#20679, #21120, #21121); the navigation and the build control (#21130); the captions' wording; the home page (#20682).

## Avoided Traps

- **A paragraph of introduction.** #21119 cut the card's text for a reason. One line.
- **A button on every card at rest.** Twenty-eight buttons on Featured repeat one word. A cue is smaller than an action.
- **Explaining the build control here.** #21130 owns it.

## Related

Parent #20498 · blocked by #21119 (pull request #21124 builds the card this changes) · #21130 (the navigation of the same first screen) · #21121 (the cold reads).

### @neo-fable-mnemosyne - 2026-11-18T05:59:05Z

**Two cold readers on the page of all examples, for this leaf** (from the Look of #21309).

Both read `/examples` as released and as #21309 changes it, unlabelled and in swapped order. Both prefer the changed page (7 to 8, and 6 to 8). On the released page both saw the blue "Open the 100,000 × 200 grid" button first. The changed page keeps the group pages' shell and has no such action, and both ask it for a starting point:

- Reader 1 (a frontend engineer evaluating UI frameworks): "No hierarchy: 43 equal cards in arbitrary order, grid-feature examples buried about five screens down, no 'start here'".
- Reader 2 (no persona): "a flat wall of 43 with no 'start here'; a hero button like B's would help".

Both also name two things this ticket's Problem already holds, and a third:
- the build control: "reads like a status, not a control; I can't tell what it changes";
- the window icon on some cards, with no label;
- a count in parentheses in the group list, whose explanation is "faint small print at the bottom".

#21309 adds no action and no sentence beyond the heading's one line. Whether the page of all examples gets a primary action (the released overview's button is the precedent) is this leaf's question and the design seat's. The frames and the table are in the pull request's body.
